text.p: Here are the highlights from Swiss newspapers on Thursday:
- Spain's King Juan Carlos was awarded the Jean-Monnet prize from the Johann Wolfgang von Goethe Foundation in Lausanne on Wednesday. The prize is for his efforts to uniting Europe.
- Butchers in Switzerland will receive inflation pay raises of 0.5 percent starting January 1.
- Some 25,000 new companies were established in Switzerland in 1995. However, the number of bankruptcies and company closings were higher than ever.
- Advertising group Publicitas acquired a majority stake in Globe Media Inc.
- Up to 15,000 people took to the streets of Fribourg in western Switzerland on Wednesday night to protest the closing of the Cardinal beer brewery, a traditional brewery established in 1788.
